node.title: Re^4: search for a string and return previous relating string if found
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Just two nitpicks: [doc://glob] splits its argument on whitespace, so $dir can't contain any whitespace - except if you do use File::Glob ':bsd_glob';, which I'd strongly recommend in this case. Also, filenames beginning with a dot will be ignored (which is probably fine but should be mentioned).
